copy_policy: Exact bytes. Independent executable tests archived as .py.txt. Original reports and original source hashes are not rewritten. Prior component/source runs do not imply combined-head qualification.

omitted.reason: Large historical public snapshots omitted from selected bundle; original freeze records their hashes. Source manifests and summary retained.

omitted.source_pattern: **/__pycache__/**, **/*.pyc, any database, credential, raw CLI log or mutable native run directory

historical_reference_notes.explanation: The older freeze precedes README follow-up notes. Both original freeze JSON and the later README are copied unchanged. This documentation reference mismatch does not relabel historical product/test evidence.
